contract: Open UI executes no JavaScript in any version. Consuming apps call public native Rust APIs and Rust callbacks over the shared Engine. Needed browser element behavior must be implemented in Rust and tested from a consuming app. Chromium alone supplies expected pixels with zero tolerance; old Open UI screenshots are immutable provenance.

changes: Honor resolved computed snapshots without reapplying parent inheritance.
Replay native overrides and inherited animation samples on resolved snapshots and their native dependents.
Remove superseded authored declarations during computed snapshot replacement.
Compute authored line-height percentages on both typed and generic Renderer payloads. The public typed setter already passed.
